description: Hand-labelled claim pairs for measuring the comparison engine. Each item is one claim from a first interview and one from a second, with the label a careful investigator would give. Labels were written before running the engine and must not be edited to make results look better - a wrong prediction is a finding about the engine, not about the label.

label_guide.match: Same thing described, no differing detail, stated plainly.
label_guide.possible_conflict: Linked to the same thing but a detail differs: time, location, people, or one denies what the other asserts.
label_guide.unclear: Agrees, but at least one side is hedged ('around', 'I think') so the detail cannot be pinned down.
label_guide.missing: The two claims are about different things and should not be paired at all.
